q: 2026 एशियाई खेलों में भारत ने निम्नलिखित में से किस टीम एवं सटीक खेल संयोजन में ऐतिहासिक स्वर्ण पदक जीते?
e:
At the 2026 Asian Games, India captured gold medals in Cricket, Hockey, and Archery, reinforcing its strong continental dominance in these disciplines (2026 एशियाई खेलों में भारत ने क्रिकेट, हॉकी और तीरंदाजी में स्वर्ण पदक जीते)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. India also won wrestling and boxing golds at the 2026 Asian Games (including Aman Sehrawat, Sujeet Kalkal, Lovlina Borgohain, and Pranavi Urs in Golf).
2. The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi in 1951.
3. The Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) governs the Asian Games every four years.
qe: At the 2026 Asian Games, India achieved a historic multi-discipline gold sweep across which combination of team and precision sports?

q: 98वें अकादमी पुरस्कार (ऑस्कर 2026) में किस फिल्म ने सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म (Best Picture) का शीर्ष सम्मान जीता?
e:
'One Battle After Another' won top honours including Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars (ऑस्कर 2026 में 'वन बैटल आफ्टर अनदर' ने शीर्ष सम्मान जीता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Academy Awards (Oscars) are presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) in Los Angeles, USA.
2. 'Anora' had won Best Picture at the 97th Oscars (2025).
3. India's first Oscar winner was Bhanu Athaiya (Best Costume Design for 'Gandhi', 1983).
qe: Which film won the top Best Picture honour at the 98th Academy Awards (Oscars 2026)?

q: 2026 में शिक्षा मंत्रालय (MoE) ने भारत की किन 5 नवीन मान्यता प्राप्त शास्त्रीय भाषाओं के लिए 5 उत्कृष्टता केंद्र (CoEs) स्थापित करने की स्वीकृति दी?
o: Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali
Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Gujarati, and Sindhi
Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali, Bodo, and Dogri
Maithili, Santhali, Kashmiri, Rajasthani, and Bhojpuri
e:
Following the Union Cabinet's October 2024 decision granting Classical Language status to Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali (raising India's total Classical Languages from 6 to 11), the Ministry of Education set up 5 dedicated Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for them (शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने मराठी, पालि, प्राकृत, असमिया और बांग्ला के लिए 5 उत्कृष्टता केंद्र स्थापित किए)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The earlier 6 Classical Languages were Tamil (2004), Sanskrit (2005), Kannada (2008), Telugu (2008), Malayalam (2013), and Odia (2014).
2. With these 5 additions, India now has 11 Classical Languages.
3. Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) is headquartered in Mysuru, Karnataka.
qe: In 2026, the Ministry of Education (MoE) approved setting up 5 Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for which newly recognized Classical Languages of India?
oe: Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali
Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Gujarati, and Sindhi
Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali, Bodo, and Dogri
Maithili, Santhali, Kashmiri, Rajasthani, and Bhojpuri

q: 2026 में भारत ने प्राचीन पांडुलिपियों के संरक्षण, डिजिटलीकरण और शैक्षणिक आदान-प्रदान के लिए किस यूरोपीय राष्ट्र के साथ द्विपक्षीय समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
e:
India and France signed a dedicated Manuscript Conservation & Digitization MoU in 2026 to deepen cultural and archival cooperation (भारत और फ्रांस ने प्राचीन पांडुलिपियों के संरक्षण व डिजिटलीकरण हेतु समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. India's National Mission for Manuscripts (NMM) was launched in 2003 under the Ministry of Culture; the Union Budget also launched the 'Gyan Bharatam Mission' for surveying and conserving over 1 crore manuscripts.
2. France is one of India's oldest strategic partners (since 1998), cooperating across defence (Rafale, Scorpene), space, and heritage.
3. National Archives of India (NAI) is located in New Delhi (originally established in 1891 in Calcutta).
qe: In 2026, India signed a bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the conservation, digitization, and academic exchange of ancient manuscripts with which European nation?

q: राष्ट्रीय समुद्री खोज एवं बचाव अभ्यास का 12वाँ संस्करण 'SAREX-2026' किस भारतीय बल द्वारा आयोजित किया गया?
e:
The Indian Coast Guard (ICG) conducts the biennial National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise (SAREX); the 12th edition (SAREX-2026) tested mass rescue operations and regional maritime coordination (12वाँ SAREX-2026 भारतीय तटरक्षक बल द्वारा आयोजित किया गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Indian Coast Guard was established on 1 February 1977 (statutory under Coast Guard Act, 1978); its motto is 'Vayam Rakshamah' (वयं रक्षामः — We Protect).
2. ICG functions under the Ministry of Defence and is the nodal agency for maritime Search and Rescue (SAR) in India's Search and Rescue Region (ISRR).
3. Indian Coast Guard Day is observed on 1 February.
qe: The 12th edition of the National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise, 'SAREX-2026', was conducted by which Indian armed/maritime force?

q: 2026 के विरासत संरक्षण समाचारों में चर्चित ऐतिहासिक मुगलकालीन 'नूरजहाँ सराय' उत्तर प्रदेश के किस ऐतिहासिक नगर में स्थित है?
e:
Nur Jahan Sarai in Agra (located on the eastern bank of the Yamuna near Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb) was highlighted in 2026 for heritage conservation and restoration (नूरजहाँ सराय आगरा में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Empress Nur Jahan also commissioned the Tomb of Itimad-ud-Daulah in Agra (1622–28), famous as the 'Baby Taj' and the first Mughal monument built entirely of white marble with Pietra Dura inlay work.
2. Agra hosts three UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and Fatehpur Sikri.
3. Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) was founded in 1861 by Alexander Cunningham.
qe: The historic Mughal-era 'Nur Jahan Sarai' (Serai Nur Mahal / Sarai of Nur Jahan), highlighted in 2026 heritage conservation news, is located near which historic city of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का प्रसिद्ध ऐतिहासिक एवं धार्मिक नगर मथुरा किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
e:
Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, Etawah, and Kalpi are situated on the banks of the Yamuna river (मथुरा यमुना नदी के तट पर स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Ayodhya is situated on the banks of the Sarayu (Ghaghara) river.
2. Lucknow, Sultanpur, and Jaunpur are on the Gomti river; Varanasi, Kanpur, Kannauj, and Mirzapur are on the Ganga river.
3. Mathura is famous for the Mathura School of Sculpture (red sandstone, Kushana period) and the Mathura Oil Refinery (IOCL).
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is located at the confluence of the Yamuna and Chambal rivers (or nearby Panchada in Etawah district), while Mathura is situated on which river?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी जनजाति मुख्यतः तराई जिलों में निवास करती है और दीपावली को शोक पर्व के रूप में मनाती है?
e:
The Tharu tribe of UP's Terai belt (claim descent from Kirat/Rajput lineage) traditionally observes Diwali as a day of mourning ('Shok Parva') (थारू जनजाति दीपावली को शोक के रूप में मनाती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tharu is the largest Scheduled Tribe in Uttar Pradesh in traditional Terai pockets (overall largest ST group in UP per 2011 Census is Gond, followed by Kharwar and Tharu).
2. Buksa (Bhoksa) tribe mainly inhabits Bijnor district; Sahariya tribe inhabits Lalitpur district.
3. UP's first tribal museum ('Tharu Janjati Sangrahalaya') was established in Balrampur district (Imliya Koder).
qe: Which of the following Uttar Pradesh tribes predominantly inhabits the Terai districts (Lakhimpur Kheri, Bahraich, Shravasti, Balrampur, Maharajganj) and observes Diwali as a day of mourning?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पक्षी और राजकीय वृक्ष क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e:
Uttar Pradesh's State Bird is the Sarus Crane (सारस / क्रौंच) and State Tree is Ashoka (अशोक / सीता अशोक)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. State Animal of UP: Barasingha / Swamp Deer (बारहसिंगा).
2. State Flower of UP: Palash / Tesu (पलाश / ढाक).
3. State Fish of UP: Chitala (चितला); State Sport: Hockey.
qe: What is the state bird and state tree of Uttar Pradesh respectively?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला भारत में आँवला (Indian Gooseberry) का सर्वाधिक उत्पादक है?
e:
Pratapgarh district of UP is India's top producer of Amla (ODOP product of Pratapgarh) (प्रतापगढ़ आँवला उत्पादन में देश में प्रथम स्थान पर है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Malihabad (Lucknow) is world-famous for Dasheri mangoes; Saharanpur for oranges/wood carving; Prayagraj for red-fleshed Allahabad Surkha guava.
2. Uttar Pradesh ranks 1st in India in the production of Wheat, Sugarcane, Potato, Mango, Amla, and Milk.
3. Indian Institute of Sugarcane Research (IISR) is located in Lucknow.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is the largest producer of Amla (Indian Gooseberry) in India?

q:
सूची-I (उत्तर प्रदेश का ऐतिहासिक स्मारक) को सूची-II (स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. बड़ा इमामबाड़ा
2. चौखंडी स्तूप
3. रानी महल
4. अकबर का मकबरा
सूची-II:
(a) सिकंदरा (आगरा)
(b) झाँसी
(c) सारनाथ (वाराणसी)
(d) लखनऊ
e:
Bara Imambara (built by Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula in 1784) is in Lucknow; Chaukhandi Stupa in Sarnath; Rani Mahal in Jhansi; Akbar's Tomb in Sikandra, Agra (1-d, 2-c, 3-b, 4-a)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bara Imambara is famous for its central hall (Bhul Bhulaiya) built without beams or pillars.
2. Rumi Darwaza in Lucknow was also built by Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula in 1784.
3. Akbar's Tomb at Sikandra was started by Akbar and completed by Jahangir (1613).
qe:
Match List-I (Historical Monument in UP) with List-II (Location) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Bara Imambara
2. Chaukhandi Stupa
3. Rani Mahal
4. Akbar's Tomb
List-II:
(a) Sikandra (Agra)
(b) Jhansi
(c) Sarnath (Varanasi)
(d) Lucknow

q: बंगाल में ब्रिटिश राजनीतिक प्रभुत्व स्थापित करने वाला प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष हुआ था?
e:
The Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757 between Robert Clive (British East India Company) and Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah of Bengal (प्लासी का युद्ध 23 जून 1757 को हुआ था)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Mir Jafar betrayed Siraj-ud-Daulah and became Nawab of Bengal after Plassey.
2. Battle of Buxar (22 October 1764, Hector Munro vs Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, Shah Alam II) led to the Treaty of Allahabad (1765) granting Diwani rights to the Company.
3. Third Battle of Panipat took place on 14 January 1761 between Ahmad Shah Abdali and the Marathas.
qe: In which year did the Battle of Plassey take place, establishing British political supremacy in Bengal?

q: 1863 में भारतीय सिविल सेवा (ICS) परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करने वाले प्रथम भारतीय निम्नलिखित में से कौन थे?
e:
Satyendranath Tagore (elder brother of Rabindranath Tagore) became the first Indian to clear the ICS examination in June 1863 (सत्येन्द्रनाथ टैगोर प्रथम भारतीय ICS अधिकारी थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Charter Act of 1853 introduced open competitive examinations for ICS (based on Macaulay Committee 1854).
2. Lord Cornwallis is called the 'Father of Civil Services in India'.
3. Subhas Chandra Bose secured 4th rank in the ICS exam in 1920 but resigned in 1921 to join the freedom struggle.
qe: Who among the following was the first Indian to qualify for the Indian Civil Service (ICS) examination in 1863?

q:
भारत शासन अधिनियम, 1919 (मॉन्टेग्यू-चेम्सफोर्ड सुधार) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसने प्रांतों में 'द्वैध शासन' (Dyarchy) लागू किया, जिससे प्रांतीय विषयों को आरक्षित और हस्तांतरित सूचियों में विभाजित किया गया।
कथन II: इसने पहली बार केंद्रीय विधायिका में द्विसदनीय व्यवस्था और प्रत्यक्ष चुनाव की शुरुआत की।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are completely accurate about the Government of India Act, 1919 (दोनों कथन 1919 के अधिनियम के विषय में पूर्णतः सत्य हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Government of India Act, 1935 abolished Dyarchy in the provinces (introducing Provincial Autonomy) and proposed Dyarchy at the Centre.
2. The 1919 Act also established the Public Service Commission (set up in 1926 on Lee Commission's recommendation).
3. The Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Morley–Minto Reforms) introduced separate electorates for Muslims.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Government of India Act, 1919 (Montagu–Chelmsford Reforms):
Statement I: It introduced 'Dyarchy' (द्वैध शासन) in the provinces, dividing provincial subjects into Reserved and Transferred lists.
Statement II: It introduced bicameralism and direct elections at the Central Legislature for the first time.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: सितंबर 1928 में दिल्ली के फिरोजशाह कोटला में 'हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन' (HSRA) की स्थापना किसने की थी?
o: Sachindra Nath Sanyal and Ram Prasad Bismil
Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and Ganesh Savarkar
Chandra Shekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, and Sukhdev
e:
Chandra Shekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and associates reorganized HRA (founded in Kanpur in 1924 by Sachindra Nath Sanyal & Bismil) into HSRA in September 1928 (चन्द्रशेखर आजाद व भगत सिंह ने 1928 में HSRA का गठन किया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw harmless bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8 April 1929 against the Public Safety Bill and Trade Disputes Bill.
2. Surya Sen ('Masterda') led the Chittagong Armoury Raid (1930).
3. V. D. Savarkar founded 'Abhinav Bharat' (1904) and authored 'The Indian War of Independence of 1857'.
qe: Who founded the 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Association' (HSRA) at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi in September 1928?
oe: Sachindra Nath Sanyal and Ram Prasad Bismil
Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and Ganesh Savarkar
Chandra Shekhar Azad, Bhagat Singh, and Sukhdev

q: बिहार स्थित प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन 'नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय' की स्थापना 5वीं शताब्दी ई. में किस गुप्त सम्राट ने की थी?
e:
Gupta emperor Kumaragupta I (Shakraditya) founded Nalanda Mahavihara; Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) studied there during Harshavardhana's reign (नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना कुमारगुप्त प्रथम ने की थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vikramashila University (Bhagalpur, Bihar) was founded by Pala ruler Dharmapala.
2. Takshashila (Taxila, now in Pakistan) was the oldest ancient centre of learning, associated with Chanakya and Panini.
3. Nalanda Mahavihara was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016.
qe: The famous ancient university of 'Nalanda' (in Bihar) was founded in the 5th century CE by which Gupta emperor?

q: भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची में पंचायतों के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आने वाले 29 विषयों की सूची शामिल है (73वें संशोधन 1992 द्वारा जोड़ी गई)?
e:
The 73rd Amendment Act (1992) added Part IX (Articles 243–243O) and the Eleventh Schedule (29 subjects for Panchayats) (ग्यारहवीं अनुसूची पंचायतों के 29 विषयों से संबंधित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The 74th Amendment Act (1992) added Part IXA and the Twelfth Schedule (18 subjects for Municipalities).
2. National Panchayati Raj Day is celebrated on 24 April (the 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993).
3. Rajasthan (Nagaur district, 2 October 1959) was the first state to inaugurate Panchayati Raj in India.
qe: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the list of 29 functional items placed within the purview of Panchayats (added by the 73rd Amendment Act, 1992)?

q: संघ और राज्यों के बीच शुद्ध कर आय के वितरण की सिफारिश करने के लिए भारत के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत प्रत्येक पाँच वर्ष में किस संवैधानिक निकाय का गठन किया जाता है?
e:
The Finance Commission is a quasi-judicial constitutional body appointed every 5 years under Article 280 (अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत वित्त आयोग का गठन राष्ट्रपति करते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The 1st Finance Commission (1951) was chaired by K. C. Neogy; the 15th by N. K. Singh; and the 16th Finance Commission (constituted Dec 2023 for 2026–31) is chaired by Dr. Arvind Panagariya.
2. CAG is established under Article 148 ('Guardian of the Public Purse').
3. Attorney General of India is appointed under Article 76 (highest law officer of India).
qe: Which Constitutional body is constituted every five years by the President of India under Article 280 to recommend distribution of net tax proceeds between the Union and the States?

q: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 के अंतर्गत विद्यालय स्तर पर कौन-सा निकाय विद्यालय विकास योजना (SDP) तैयार करने और विद्यालय के संचालन की निगरानी करने के लिए अनिवार्य है (जिसमें कम से कम 75% सदस्य अभिभावक होते हैं)?
e:
Section 21 of the RTE Act, 2009 mandates forming a School Management Committee (SMC) in every government and aided school, with 75% parents/guardians and 50% women representation (विद्यालय प्रबंधन समिति या SMC का गठन अनिवार्य है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Section 22 mandates that the SMC prepare a three-year School Development Plan (SDP).
2. RTE Act (2009) also prohibits corporal punishment (Section 17) and private tuition by teachers (Section 28).
3. National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) monitors child rights under the RTE Act.
qe: Under the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which body at the school level is mandated to prepare the School Development Plan (SDP) and monitor school functioning (with at least 75% parent/guardian members)?

q: भारतीय संविधान का संरक्षक और अंतिम व्याख्याकार कौन है?
e:
The Supreme Court of India (Part V, Articles 124–147) is the custodian, guardian, and final interpreter of the Constitution as well as the guarantor of Fundamental Rights (सर्वोच्च न्यायालय संविधान का संरक्षक व अंतिम व्याख्याकार है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Supreme Court of India was inaugurated on 28 January 1950; H. J. Kania was the first Chief Justice of India (CJI).
2. Article 129 declares the Supreme Court a 'Court of Record'.
3. Under Article 142, the Supreme Court can pass decrees necessary for doing 'complete justice'.
qe: Who is the guardian and final interpreter of the Constitution of India?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने अनुच्छेद 352 में 'आंतरिक अशांति' (Internal Disturbance) शब्द के स्थान पर 'सशस्त्र विद्रोह' (Armed Rebellion) शब्द प्रतिस्थापित किया?
e:
The 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978 replaced 'internal disturbance' with 'armed rebellion', mandated written Cabinet advice for proclaiming National Emergency, and protected Articles 20 and 21 from suspension (44वें संशोधन 1978 ने 'सशस्त्र विद्रोह' शब्द जोड़ा)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. National Emergency (Art. 352) has been proclaimed 3 times in India: 1962 (China war), 1971 (Pakistan war), and 1975 (internal emergency).
2. Financial Emergency (Article 360) has NEVER been proclaimed in India.
3. President's Rule (Article 356) can continue for a maximum of 3 years (with parliamentary approval every 6 months and special conditions beyond 1 year).
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act restored the judicial review of constitutional amendments and replaced the term 'Internal Disturbance' with 'Armed Rebellion' in Article 352?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के मिर्जापुर के निकट से गुजरने वाली किस याम्योत्तर (देशांतर) रेखा को भारतीय मानक समय (IST) रेखा के रूप में अपनाया गया है?
e:
82°30' East longitude is the Standard Meridian of India (IST = GMT + 5 hours 30 minutes), passing through 5 states: UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh (82°30' पूर्वी देशांतर भारत की मानक समय रेखा है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N) and IST meridian (82°30' E) intersect each other in Koriya/Manendragarh district of Chhattisgarh.
2. India's longitudinal extent is 68°7' E (Guhar Moti, Gujarat) to 97°25' E (Kibithu, Arunachal Pradesh) — roughly a 2-hour local time difference.
3. Indira Point (Great Nicobar) is India's southernmost point, while Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of the Indian mainland.
qe: Which meridian is adopted as the Indian Standard Time (IST) meridian, passing near Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान एशियाई शेर (Asiatic Lion) के अंतिम प्राकृतिक आवास के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Gir National Park (Gujarat) is the sole wild habitat of the Asiatic Lion (गिर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान एशियाई शेरों का एकमात्र प्राकृतिक आवास है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Jim Corbett National Park (Uttarakhand, est. 1936 as Hailey NP) is India's first National Park and where Project Tiger launched in 1973.
2. Kaziranga National Park (Assam) is famous for the Great Indian One-Horned Rhinoceros.
3. Dachigam National Park (J&K) protects the Kashmir Stag (Hangul); Keibul Lamjao (Manipur) is the world's only floating National Park (Sangai deer).
qe: Which of the following National Parks is famous as the last natural habitat of the Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica)?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किस राज्य में महिला साक्षरता दर सबसे कम थी?
e:
According to Census 2011, Bihar recorded the lowest overall literacy rate (61.80%) as well as the lowest female literacy rate (51.50%), closely followed by Rajasthan (52.12%) (जनगणना 2011 में बिहार की महिला साक्षरता दर 51.50% सबसे कम थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Kerala topped both overall literacy (94.00%) and female literacy (92.07%).
2. India's overall literacy rate in Census 2011 was 74.04% (Males: 82.14%, Females: 65.46%).
3. Uttar Pradesh's overall literacy rate was 67.68% (Males: 77.28%, Females: 57.18%).
qe: As per Census 2011, which state of India had the lowest female literacy rate?

q: भारत की कौन-सी पंचवर्षीय योजना तीव्र भारी औद्योगीकरण पर बल देने वाले 'महालनोबिस मॉडल' से प्रसिद्ध रूप से जुड़ी है?
e:
The Second Five-Year Plan (1956–61) was based on the P. C. Mahalanobis Model and established major steel plants at Bhilai (USSR), Durgapur (UK), and Rourkela (West Germany) (द्वितीय पंचवर्षीय योजना महालनोबिस मॉडल पर आधारित थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. First Five-Year Plan (1951–56) was based on the Harrod–Domar Model, prioritizing agriculture and irrigation (Bhakra Nangal, Hirakud dams).
2. Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–78) highlighted 'Garibi Hatao' (poverty eradication).
3. National Statistics Day is celebrated on 29 June on Prof. P. C. Mahalanobis's birth anniversary.
qe: Which Five-Year Plan of India is famously associated with the 'Mahalanobis Model' emphasizing rapid heavy industrialization?

q: भारत में प्रमुख कृषि फसलों के लिए न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) की आधिकारिक सिफारिश आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) की स्वीकृति से पूर्व किस निकाय द्वारा की जाती है?
o: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)
e:
CACP (Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices, est. 1965 as Agricultural Prices Commission) recommends MSPs for 22 mandated crops plus Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane (कृषि लागत और मूल्य आयोग — CACP — MSP की सिफारिश करता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. FCI (established 1965) handles procurement, buffer stocking, and PDS distribution of foodgrains.
2. MSP covers 14 Kharif crops, 6 Rabi crops, and 2 commercial crops (copra and raw jute).
3. Prof. M. S. Swaminathan ('Father of India's Green Revolution', Bharat Ratna 2024) chaired the National Commission on Farmers.
qe: Minimum Support Price (MSP) for major agricultural crops in India is officially recommended by which body before approval by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)?
oe: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन किसी देश के 'भुगतान संतुलन' (Balance of Payments) को सबसे सटीक रूप से परिभाषित करता है?
o: Difference between government revenue receipts and revenue expenditure
Systematic record of all economic transactions between residents of a country and the rest of the world during a given period
Difference between exports and imports of visible merchandise goods only
Total foreign exchange reserves held by the central bank
e:
Balance of Payments (BoP) systematically records ALL economic transactions (Current Account + Capital/Financial Account) between domestic residents and the rest of the world in a year (भुगतान संतुलन एक वर्ष में शेष विश्व के साथ सभी आर्थिक लेनदेन का व्यवस्थित विवरण है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Difference between visible merchandise exports and imports ONLY is called 'Balance of Trade' (BoT).
2. Current Account includes merchandise trade, services (invisibles), remittances, and investment income.
3. India's BoP crisis of 1991 triggered the historic LPG (Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) reforms.
qe: Which of the following best defines 'Balance of Payments' (BoP) of a country?
oe: Difference between government revenue receipts and revenue expenditure
Systematic record of all economic transactions between residents of a country and the rest of the world during a given period
Difference between exports and imports of visible merchandise goods only
Total foreign exchange reserves held by the central bank

q: मानव-जनित ग्लोबल वार्मिंग (वैश्विक तापन) में सर्वाधिक योगदान देने वाली ग्रीनहाउस गैस कौन-सी है?
e:
Carbon dioxide (CO₂), emitted mainly by burning fossil fuels, is the primary anthropogenic greenhouse gas driving global warming (कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड मानव-जनित ग्लोबल वार्मिंग की प्रमुख ग्रीनहाउस गैस है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Major greenhouse gases: Water vapour (naturally most abundant), CO₂, Methane (CH₄), Nitrous oxide (N₂O), and Fluorinated gases (HFCs, PFCs, SF₆).
2. Kyoto Protocol (1997) and Paris Agreement (2015) are key international climate treaties under UNFCCC.
3. India has committed to achieving Net-Zero carbon emissions by 2070 (Panchamrit pledge at COP26 Glasgow).
qe: Which gas is the most abundant greenhouse gas contributing to human-induced global warming?

q: कंप्यूटर प्रणाली में किस प्रकार की मेमोरी अस्थायी (volatile) होती है (बिजली बंद होने पर डेटा मिट जाता है) और सक्रिय रूप से चल रहे प्रोग्रामों को संग्रहीत करती है?
e:
RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile primary memory used by the CPU for active programs and data; ROM, HDD, and SSD are non-volatile (RAM अस्थायी प्राथमिक मेमोरी है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Cache memory (SRAM) sits between CPU and main RAM for ultra-fast access.
2. 1 Byte = 8 Bits; 1 Kilobyte (KB) = 1,024 Bytes; 1 Megabyte (MB) = 1,024 KB.
3. BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) firmware is stored in non-volatile ROM/EEPROM.
qe: In computer systems, which type of memory is volatile (loses its stored data when power is turned off) and stores actively running programs?

q: NEP 2020 के अंतर्गत उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों में छात्रों को अपने शैक्षणिक क्रेडिट संग्रहीत और स्थानांतरित करने की सुविधा देने वाला भारत सरकार का डिजिटल मंच कौन-सा है?
e:
Academic Bank of Credits (ABC), integrated with DigiLocker and APAAR ID ('One Nation, One Student ID'), stores students' academic credits digitally to allow flexible multiple entry-exit under NEP 2020 (अकादमिक बैंक ऑफ क्रेडिट्स छात्रों के शैक्षणिक क्रेडिट का डिजिटल भंडार है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. APAAR stands for Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry.
2. National Digital University (NDU) and PM e-VIDYA are complementary digital education initiatives.
3. e-NAM is National Agriculture Market; GeM is Government e-Marketplace for public procurement.
qe: Which Indian EdTech / Digital Public Infrastructure platform launched by NCERT and the Ministry of Education enables students to store and transfer academic credits across higher education institutions under NEP 2020?
